01-what-is-computer.md.description: Module 01 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 1 --- A computer is an electronic device that accepts data as input, processes it according to a set of instructions (called a program), and produces meaningful output (called information). It can also store data for future use. In simple words: A computer takes raw data, works on it, and gives you useful results. CCC Exam Tip: The definition of a computer is frequently asked. 02-computer-components.md.description: Module 01 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 2 --- A computer system is made up of several components that work together. 03-hardware-software.md.title: Hardware and Software
03-hardware-software.md.description: Module 01 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 3 --- Hardware refers to all the physical parts of a computer that you can see and touch. If you can hold it in your hand, it is hardware. Examples of Hardware: - Monitor, Keyboard, Mouse, Printer, Speaker - CPU, Motherboard, RAM stick, Hard Disk - Pen Drive, CD/DVD, Scanner, Webcam Think of hardware as the body of a computer — without hardware, there is nothing to run programs on. --- Software is a set...

04-data-representation.md.title: Data Representation in Computers
04-data-representation.md.description: Module 01 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 4 --- Computers understand only two things: 0 and 1. Everything — text, images, videos, music — is stored as combinations of 0s and 1s inside the computer. This is because computers use electrical signals, and a signal can be either ON (1) or OFF (0). --- - The smallest unit of data in a computer - A bit can hold only one of two values: 0 or 1 - "Bit" comes from Binary Digit - A group of 8 bits = 1 Byte -...

05-ict-applications.md.title: ICT Applications in Daily Life
05-ict-applications.md.description: Module 01 — CCC Exam Preparation | Topic 5 --- ICT stands for Information and Communication Technology. It refers to all technologies used for handling, processing, storing, and communicating information. ICT includes computers, the internet, mobile phones, software, and networks.
